title: Shopping cart totals
tagline: Adding a second item replaces the first, the subtotal breaks, and a 10% coupon takes far too much.
lookFor: Inside a condition, `=` sets a value. `===` compares. Look for a single `=`.
`reduce` needs a starting value. For a sum, pass `0`.

bugs.symptom: Adding a second product overwrites the first
hints: Look very closely at the function passed to `cart.items.find`.
bugs.cause: `i.sku = sku` sets the value instead of comparing it. So every add 'finds' the first line and changes it.

bugs.symptom: Subtotal is '[object Object]…' or the cart crashes when empty
hints: With no starting value, what is `sum` on the first step?
bugs.cause: Without a start value, `reduce` begins with the first item (an object), not 0. An empty cart crashes.
The coupon says `percent: 10`, but the code multiplies by 10 instead of 0.10.

bugs.symptom: Hidden test: 'save10' in lowercase is rejected
hints: How are coupon names written in the catalog?
bugs.cause: The lookup needs exact capitals, so 'save10' fails.
